content: Maya fuwain okkol Isar sahabi
Tarfore Isaye elan goribolla edde Allar raijjor mutallek kušir hóbor tobolig goribolla fara fara, šohore šohore gura šuru goijje. Ar fũwati he barozon sahabi,

edde zara bod ruhuttu uddar faiye, biyaramottu aram faiye hendilla hoekzon mayafuwain o fũwati aššil. Hitarar butore aššilde: Moriyam zare Mogdaleni hoi o ḍakito edde zar butottu hãttuwa bod ruh niyoli gilgoi.
Joana ze badša Herudor menezar Kusar bou. Susanna edde aro bout mayafuwain okkol. Hitarar nizor šombottittu Isa edde he barozon sahabi okkolore solaito.
Ekzon bizor dana lagoyar kahani
Ar zẽtte beša beši manuš okkol bout šohor okkolottu aiyore Isar hãse ai birgorer. Toi Isaye hitarare šikka dibolla ei kahanigan hoiye:

content.text: "Ekzon sašaye hitar bizor dana šiṛibolla giye. Biz šiṛibar šomot hodun biz fõtor kinare foijje, hin manušor fortole oiye edde faik okkole hái felaiye.
Ar hodun biz šil meṛir uwore foijje edde hin heṛe fuiṭṭe, kintu fanir obafe saragun fuwai gilgoi.
Abar hodun biz keṛarzaliwala zagat foijje, he saragun keṛarzalir fũwati bari uiṭṭe, edde hinore keṛarzaliye sibi dori raikke.
Abar hodun biz bala zobinot foijje, hin bari uiṭṭe edde ek šot gun gula diye."

content: Ei kahanigan hoi bade Isaye zur gola loi hodde,

content.text: "Zar han ase hite funok!"

content: Hibar sahabi okkole ei mesal kahaniganor mani ki fusar goijje.
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Allar raijjor gufon soiyi tũwarare zainto diya oiye, kintu hitarar hãse kahanir mesale howa oiye, zene,
"'Hitara deke kintu no deke,
ar fune kintu no buze.'
"Ei mesal kahaniganor mani oilde endilla: Biz oilde Allar kalam.
Fõtor kinare foijjede bizor mesal hitarare diya oiye, zara kalam fune, kintu Šoitane ai hitarar dilottu hiyan tuli loi zagoi. Henot hitara ar hiyanor uwore iman ani no fare boli uddar oi no fare.

Šil meṛit foijjede bizor mesal hitarare diya oiye, ze he kalam fune edde kuširsate mani lo, kintu hitarattu hiyanor hono šiyõr nai; hitara olfo dinolla biššaš gore, ar forikkar šomot hitara fissa fori zagoi.

Keṛarzaliwala zagat foijjede bizor mesal hitarare diya oiye, zara kalam fune kintu zibon fõtot soilte soilte, šongšari sinta bafona, dón šombotti edde aram aiyešor maze hin sibot fori zagoi, hetolla zibonot hono fona fól deha no de.
Bala zobinot foijjede bizor mesal hitarare diya oiye ze soiyi šorol mone he kalam fune, edde mojbut gori kolobor butore dori rake ar hitarar sobori zibonot fona fól dore.

content: Deššir nise serag

content.text: "Ar serag zali honokiye dešši loi guri no rake otóba haṭor tole no rake, kintu serag boiṛonir uwore rake, zene zara butore za, hitara fohor deki fare.
Henot en gufon kissu no takibo zin forhaš no oibo otóba en sufaiya kissu no takibo zin zana no zaibo ba deha no zaibo.
Hetolla tũwara hondilla gori funor he babute diyan do, kiyollahoile zattu ase hitare aro diya oibo. Ar zattu nai hite hitattu zin ase boli mone gore, hin o hitattu loifela oibo."

content: Isa Mosi loi zarar asol egenafoti
Ar Isar ma edde báiboinain okkole Isare saito aišše. Kintu hitara mainšor zamilalla buli Isa loi deha gori no faijjil.
Bade ekzone Isare hodde: "Õnor ma báiboinain okkole baire tiyai taikke, õne loi deha goitto sar."
Kintu hibaye hodde,

content.text: "Itara zara Allar kalam fune edde he bafe falon gore, hitara oilde ãr ma edde báiboinain."

content: Isaye tuwan tamaiye
Ek din Isa edde Isar sahabi okkol ekkan not uiṭṭe. Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Solo, ãra doriyar ofarot zai."

content: Toi hitara no sajje,
edde hitara šor tulidi no solat maze Isa gumot fori giyegoi. Ar doriyat en tuwan oiye, henot hitarar nogan faniye furaiya owa šuru goijje. Henot hitara beša beši bifodot fori giyegoi.
Hitara Isar hãse zai Isare gumottu tulidi hodde, "Malik, Malik ãra ḍufizairgoi!" Hetunot Isa uṛi boyarore edde goirore dõk diye, ar boyar edde goir hanta oiye, hár kissu nirol oi giyegoi.
Tarfore Isaye sahabi okkolore hodde,

content.text: "Tũwarar biššaš hoṛe?"

content: Kintu hitara ḍore ammuwak oiye edde ekzonore ekzone hodde: "Iba honnuwa? Hibaye boyar edde doriyare hokum gore, ar hitara hibar hota mane!"
Isaye horaf zine faiya manušore aram goijje
Tarfore hitara Geraseni okkolor dešot no loi fõisse, ziyan Galilor dusora faror mikka.
Ar Isa zẽtte farot laimme he šohoror ekzon bod ruhuye faiya manuš loi deha oiye. Bout dinottu loti ei manušwaye hor no finder edde górot no taker, kintu hoboror gãtot taker.
Hite Isar sarme meṛit uite fori guzori hodde: "Oh Isa, šoktiwala Allar Fut, ãlloi õnor ki tallukat? Õnor hãse ãi foriyad gorir, ãre zontrona no diyo!"

Isaye he napak ruhure manušwar butottu niyoli zaito hokum dilde hetolla hite hen goijje. Ei ruhuye bout din oite he manušware doijje. Ar hitare siyol edde beri loi bandi rakile o hite siyol siri bod ruhor kemotaye nirzon zagat zaitogoi.
Isaye hitare fusar goredde,

content.text: "Tor nam ki?"

content: Hite hodde, "Bahani" kiyollahoile hitar butore bout bod ruh okkol aššil.
Tarfore hitarare aṭai gãtot no defeṛaibolla Isare foriyad gora šuru goijje.
Heṛe faharor uwore ḍõr ek šuworor zak soredde aššil, he napak ruhugune Isare foriyad goijje šuworgunor butore hitarare goilto ezajot dibolla, ar hibaye hitarare ezajot diye.
Toi bod ruh okkole he manušwar butottu niyoli zai šuworgunor butore góillegoi. Henot he šuworor zakgun zure dũri faharor haindat giye edde henttu fori fori fanit dufi moijje.
Zara šuworor zak sorail hitara ei hanḍo deki henttu dai giyegoi. Ar ei goṭonaganore he šohorot edde farar hár zagat zai hoiyegoi.

Ki oiye hin saibolla hetunot manuš okkol niyoli aišše. Hitara Isar hãse ai dekedde, ze manušwar butottu bod ruh niyoli giyegoi, hite hor findi šuida oi Isar ṭengor ḍake boi taikke, hen deki manuš okkole ḍoraiye.
Zara he goṭonagan dekkil, hitara he bod ruye faiya manušwa ki bafe aram oil hin manuš okkolore hoiye.
Toi Geraseni elehar sairo mikkar šomosto manuš okkole Isare beši ḍoraiye hetolla hitara beggune Isare henttu zaiboilla foriyad goijje. Toi Isaye uiṭṭe edde henttu uwafes firi giyegoi.
Ze manušwattu bod ruh niyoli gilgoi, hite Isar fũwati zai faribo ne fusar goijje.
Kintu Isaye hitare en hoi bidai diye,

content.text: "Tui tor górot zagoi edde tolla ze ḍõr ham Allaye goijje, hin mainšore hogoi."

content: Henot hite farat firi giyegoi edde Isaye hitalla ze ḍõr ham goijje hin šohoror agagura hoiye.
Ek mora zerfuwa edde ek biyaraimma maya fuwa
Isa zẽtte firi aišše manuš okkole hibare kuši mone goisse, kiyollahoile hitara beggune hiballa entezar gori aššil.
Ar so, Zairus name ekzon manuš, Isar sarme aišše. Hite aššilde muzolišhanar ekzon neta. Hite Isar fot fori hitar górot zaibolla Isare foriyad gora šuru goijje.
Kiyollahoile hitattu lehar ek zi aššil, boyoš hom beši baro bosor, ar hiba morar mukot. Isa heṛe zadde šomot manuš okkole hibare har ḍakottu ṭelaṭeli goijje.
Heṛe butore ekzon beṛi maya fuwa aššil ze baro bosorfan kunzari biyaram loi duk fat ase. Ḍaktor okkolor fise har šombotti beggunore horos gori felai bade o honokiye hibare bala gori no fare.
Hibaye Isar fisottu zai Isar horor kuna suiye. Toi hehon hibar kunzari bon oi giyegoi.
Toi Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ãre hone suiye?"

content: Kintu beggune ošikar goijje. Fitore hodde, "Huzur, mainše har ḍakottu ṭelaṭeliye zafdiforer."
Toi Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ãre hono ekzone suiye, ãi ṭer faiyi ãr butottu šokti giyede."

content: Mayafuwawaye dekedde hiba luwai tai no faribo, hetunot hiba hafi hafi Isar munttu aišše. Hibaye Isar sarme uite fori kiyolla Isare suiye edde kibafe hehon hibar kunzari bon oiye, in okkol har manušor sarme hibaye hoi funaiye.
Toi Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Oh zi, tor biššaše tore bala goijje, arame górot firi zagoi."

content: Isa ehon o hota howat ase, hen šomot muzolišhanar netar górottu ekzon manuš aiyore hodde, "Tũwar zi mori giyoi. Huzurore loi ar diddari no goris."
Ei hota funiyore Isaye Zairusore hodde,

content.text: "No ḍorais, bolke biššaš gor, henot hiba aram oibo."

content: Bade Isa zehon Zairusor górot fõisse, Fitor, Yakub, Yuhanna edde he zerfuwar babma sara ar honokiyore Isaye góror butore golito no de.
Beggune hiballa handahaṛi edde bilag gorer kintu Isaye hodde,

content.text: "No haindo! Hiba no more, gum zadde."

content: Hitara hen funi Isare ṭaṭṭa uraiye, kiyollahoile hiba mori giyegoide hiyan hitara zainto.
Kintu Isaye hibar hat dori ḍaki hodde,

content.text: "Oh zi, uṭ!"

content: Henot hibar foran firi aišše edde hiba hehon uṛi tiyaiye. Ar Isaye hibare kissu haito dito hoiye.
Henot hibar babma ekkubare ammuwak oi giyegoi, kintu Isaye hitarare ei goṭonar hotagan honokiyore no hoibolla mana goijje.
